Russia and Ukraine resume strikes as Trump's 'energy ceasefire' collapses, and US lawmakers unveil a bill targeting Wall Street bosses with Epstein links.
text.au: Donald Trump drops a plan to livestream the execution of a man convicted of killing 13 people at Fort Hood, after global condemnation. Resources minister Madeleine King faces calls to correct her claim that all Beetaloo basin emissions will be offset. An inquest hears doctors recommended an involuntary mental health assessment of Elizabeth Struhs' mother, and Russia and Ukraine resume strikes as Trump's 'energy ceasefire' collapses.
text.europe: Russia and Ukraine resume strikes as Donald Trump's 'energy ceasefire' collapses, with Moscow sending drones at central Ukraine and Kyiv set to hit Russian oil refineries again. Trump drops a plan to livestream the execution of the Fort Hood gunman after global condemnation. Albania's prime minister, Edi Rama, refuses to resign after three days of student-led protests, and Serbia's Aleksandar Vučić faces claims he secretly pushed a Trump Tower in Belgrade.
text.international: Donald Trump drops a plan to livestream the execution of the Fort Hood gunman after global condemnation, though the man will still be executed.
